name: Asuka-san wa Nabikanai
original_name: アスカさんはなびかない
source:
The female lead is the student council president of a prestigious school.

She is beautiful, attractive, intelligent, and possesses exceptional motor skills as if heaven endowed her with not just two but five or six blessings. She is truly a flower on a high peak and has rejected innumerable male confessions.

As a commoner, I thought she was the kind of woman who was way out of my league......

"Hey, Asuma!"

"Yes?"

As I walked down the corridor after school, a teacher called out to me, and as I was about to respond, I heard a woman's voice behind me. I turned around and saw the student council president, who is also nicknamed "Ice Princess."

"No, the one that I called is "Asuma"."

"......!!!"

Her clear white cheeks turned red in an instant. It was the first time that I saw her face like that.

"E.. Excuse me!!"

From that moment on, I learned the student council president's name was Asuka Shishidou, and I caught her attention through a notebook I had picked up earlier.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/asunabi/story.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
女主是某名校的学生会主席。

她美丽、迷人、聪明，而且拥有非凡的运动能力，仿佛上天赐予她的不是二福，而是五六福。她真是巅峰之花，拒绝过无数男人的表白。

作为一个平民，我以为她是那种我根本无法比拟的女人……

“喂，阿斯玛！”

“是的？”

当我放学后走在走廊上时，一位老师喊我，当我正要回应时，我听到身后有一个女人的声音。我一回头，看到了绰号“冰公主”的学生会长。

“不，我叫的那个是‘阿斯玛’。”

“……！！！”

白皙的脸颊瞬间变得通红。我还是第一次看到她这样的脸。

“呃……对不起！！”

从那时起，我知道了学生会主席的名字是狮子道明日香，我通过之前拿起的笔记本引起了她的注意。

[翻译编辑自[url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/asunabi/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
